notes: The telemetry catalog names this platform 'ceos' (the containerized EOS in the lab); 'ceos' is a platform ALIAS of the eos profile, not a second product. The CLI binding is deliberately cisco-iosxe: EOS speaks the Cisco IOS-XE show-command grammar, which is why the protocol-diagnostics catalog renders EOS devices in that dialect. That is a SHOW-GRAMMAR claim only and is a separate axis from the hardening binding, which is its OWN dialect (`arista`): EOS shares IOS' show grammar but not its configuration grammar (no `line vty`, no `service password-encryption`, an eAPI/gNMI management plane IOS has no analogue for), so borrowing the cisco-iosxe hardening bindings would have produced confident verdicts against lines EOS never writes. config_capture LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-02 on lab leaf1 (172.40.40.21, cEOSLab 4.36.0.1F): `show running-config` over one non-interactive SSH exec returns the whole configuration with no pager engaged, and two consecutive captures were byte-identical; the two header lines it stamps (`! Command: ...`, `! device: ...`) are exactly what the eos-command and eos-device-banner volatile rules strip. NOTE the privilege prerequisite, which is a DEPLOYMENT fact and not a profile one: EOS answers `show running-config` only at privilege 15, so the capture account must be authorized into privileged exec (`aaa authorization exec default local` with a privilege-15 role); a level-1 account is answered with `% Invalid input (privileged mode required)` and internal/configstore refuses that capture rather than storing the banner as a config version.

commands.ssh_bgp_edge: show ip bgp summary vrf all

snmp_configgen.v3_template:
snmp-server group CORRELIX v3 priv
snmp-server user <<sec_name>> CORRELIX v3 auth sha <<auth_key>> priv aes <<priv_key>>

os_version_probe.notes: OS-VERSION SOURCE LADDER (internal/osprobe). The lab's cEOS leaves stream OpenConfig over gNMI, which is why the OpenConfig system path leads and the component path is the fallback for a chassis that publishes the version per-component. doc_claimed all the same: the change that authored this block did not Get either path or run `show version` on a leaf, and says so rather than inheriting this profile's live_validated fidelity, which was earned by its telemetry paths, not by these. cli_version_pattern reads the `Software image version: 4.32.0F` line and deliberately not `Internal build version: 4.32.0F-36993274.4320F`, which is a build id; the captured class therefore excludes the hyphen so a build suffix can never reach a CVE range comparison.
